changes_allowed: AT25 engineering binding and offline evidence aggregation only. Existing product/test/protocol/literal/budget bytes unchanged. Formal whole_status remains NOT_RUN.
aggregation_rules: Pin one actual source SHA/run and exact selected test-node identities. Normalize only terminal pytest phase suffix (setup/call/teardown) to link each fixture baseline. Reject mixed/old/missing run or source evidence.

Reconstruct expected affected/preserved UUID sets from the unchanged frozen literal scenario/Case symbols and the matching current baseline stable-step UUID mapping. Check recorded expected fields equal this independent reconstruction; do not trust recorded missed_count/wrong_count.
Validate each UUID belongs to the exact baseline five steps, affected/preserved disjoint and cover the baseline; reject duplicate/missing fields rather than substituting zeros.
Within that pinned window, deduplicate by scenario/Case and compare the full observation payload excluding only metadata such as UTC. Duplicate disagreement is failure, never last-wins or averaged.

Four-parameter source identification test has source-graph plus reverse-lookup repeats: expected physical oracle shape is 14 records, unique 8. Existing selected-capacity test contributes its own 2 unique records. These are planned cardinalities, not execution results or passing counts.

Known-source observations and intentional UNKNOWN observations are separate groups. UNKNOWN conservative full-case expansion is not in the known FN/FP denominator and is not a success of fine-grained precision.

FN=expected_affected minus actual_affected; FP=actual_affected minus expected_affected. Preserved symmetric difference is reported separately and can encode the same classification errors; do not sum it again into an error total.
Name FN/FP dependency-impact-identification errors, not actual text modifications or fulfilled business correctness. Keep all actual values and rates unset until a real run.
runtime_scope: The four-parameter identification test checks stored plans and original_rows for A/B unchanged. original_rows covers 12 scoped Case-record classes; it is not all public tables or all SQLite stores.

Selected-capacity action separately proves old P2 VERIFY409, explicit local ADOPT, new actual holds/bundle, current comparison+explicit resource-link rebind, P2-P5 VERIFY and exact old P1 lock. Its six old reservation/link table row sets remain exact subsets.

The selected-capacity at-results old_verify_status variable comes from the earlier loop final refusal object; both A and B runtime assertions require409. Do not describe that field as two independently retained per-Case raw HTTP receipts.

The action uses original finite synthetic resource rules and existing rebind protocol; replacement_formal_approval remains NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Do not turn local output verification into real approval or business completion.
AT26 material actual correction/reverification evidence may be cited with its own SHA/window, never added as new AT25 test passes.

reporting.engineering: Only actual original runner PARTIAL_PASS/FAIL after frozen source binding; no inferred current scores.

evidence_requirements: Independent arithmetic can rerun over saved records without repeating PG scenarios.
Original specification/oracle hashes and unrelated acceptance bindings remain unchanged.
Actual token and prefix scan before public archive; exclude private redaction/session files.
independent_execution: None: no PG, model, network, permissions, repository or Git writes in this design review.
